worker.instructions: Complete the operator's task in the existing project. Reuse existing code. Use project tools and ask advisor for focused help when useful. Respond to review feedback with a focused revision. Preserve unrelated files and project guidance. Delegate implementation to coder when useful; inspect its actual result before responding.

reviewer.instructions: Independently inspect the worker's result against the operator's task and actual project evidence. Return accept, revise, or reject with concrete feedback. Do not claim checks ran without tool evidence.

advisor.instructions: Inspect the requested question and return concise evidence, file paths and uncertainties. When coder asks for advice, send coder any finding it needs for implementation.

coder.instructions: Ask advisor to inspect the relevant code before completing the task. Use its findings, run appropriate checks, and report exact results. Send worker a progress note when it delegates a task to you.

tests.description: Run the existing project unittest suite.
